projects.name: Raqcoin
projects.chart_note: Renamed in 2022; old Rainbow parameters broken
projects.milestone_note: The 2018 milestone is ABCMint genesis, not UOV deployment. Community materials describe a 2022 rename.
projects.consensus_note: PoW.
projects.signing_note: RainbowPro and UOV configurations; multisig is a separate capability.
projects.agility_note: Key configuration selects the signing scheme. Existing keys do not change automatically.
projects.caveat: The guide lists Rainbow configuration 274 as the default. Legacy ABCMint Rainbow parameters have a public break. New configurations require separate analysis; NIST UOV candidate parameters are not Raqcoin deployment parameters.

projects.name: Mochimo
projects.chart_note: Website says PoS since Oct 2026; public code is PoW
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet launched in June 2018.
projects.consensus_note: The project website states a switch from PoW to PoS in October 2026; the public node repository (v3.1.0-beta, April 2026) still contains PoW code only.
projects.signing_note: WOTS+ transaction signatures.
projects.agility_note: One active signing scheme in the reviewed material.
projects.caveat: The switch to proof of stake rests on the project's website alone; the public node repository still shows PoW code. The signing scheme remained WOTS+. No claim that a future protocol upgrade could never change it.

projects.name: QRL
projects.chart_note: 1.x mainnet: PoW; 2.0 PoS: testnet
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet launched in June 2018.
projects.consensus_note: QRL 1.x mainnet uses PoW; QRL 2.0 PoS was a testnet in this snapshot.
projects.signing_note: XMSS transaction signatures.
projects.agility_note: Hash-function choice and descriptor fields; not arbitrary switching between signature families.
projects.caveat: XMSS is stateful. The RFC size example is not QRL transaction serialization.

projects.name: Nexus
projects.chart_note: Falcon is optional; Brainpool remains classical
projects.milestone_note: November 2019 is the Tritium upgrade, not the original chain genesis in 2014.
projects.consensus_note: PoW and PoS channels.
projects.signing_note: Opt-in Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures remain valid.
projects.agility_note: Signature chains commit to a subsequent key and scheme.
projects.caveat: Do not treat every Nexus account as post-quantum.

projects.name: Tidecoin
projects.chart_cryptography: Falcon-512 live; ML-DSA in upgrade code
projects.chart_note: Multi-scheme upgrade not active on mainnet
projects.milestone_note: Genesis was December 27, 2020.
projects.consensus_note: PoW; the reviewed default mainnet parameters disable the AuxPoW activation gate.
projects.signing_note: Falcon-512 active; Falcon-1024 and ML-DSA exist in upgrade code.
projects.agility_note: Multiple schemes are implemented behind an activation gate.
projects.caveat: Implemented upgrade support does not establish that it is active on mainnet.

projects.name: Starknet
projects.chart_cryptography: STARK proofs; opt-in Falcon-512 account classes
projects.chart_note: Independent L1: research proposal stage
projects.milestone_note: November 2021 is L2 Mainnet Alpha, not an independent L1 launch.
projects.consensus_note: Ethereum L2 with a phased PoS rollout.
projects.signing_note: STARK validity proofs. Falcon-512 account classes are declared on mainnet (an OpenZeppelin pre-release and S2morrow); none has a published audit.
projects.agility_note: Account abstraction and contract upgrades can change account verification logic.
projects.caveat: The Falcon-512 account classes are pre-release or experimental and have no published audit, and existing accounts must move to them one by one. Ethereum settlement and bridge dependencies remain. The L1 vote supported research, not a move.

projects.name: Abelian
projects.chart_note: Jan 2026: ABEL-ETHash + ABEL-Nakamoto
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet launched in April 2022.
projects.consensus_note: Dual PoW: ABEL-ETHash and ABEL-Nakamoto after the Aconcagua upgrade.
projects.signing_note: Custom lattice-based PQRingCT/PQRingCTX schemes.
projects.agility_note: Versioned cryptographic schemes; mining algorithm choice is a separate matter.
projects.caveat: These schemes are not ML-DSA. Dual PoW does not mean PoW plus PoS. QDay is a separate L2.

projects.name: Algorand
projects.chart_note: Chain launched in 2019; consensus still classical
projects.milestone_note: The timeline uses the 2022 State Proofs milestone. The chain launched in 2019.
projects.consensus_note: Pure Proof of Stake.
projects.signing_note: Falcon State Proofs and opt-in Falcon account authorization.
projects.agility_note: Rekeying and programmable authorization; native Falcon-1024 accounts are also documented.
projects.caveat: State Proofs and account signing have different roles. Consensus participation keys remain classical; app and wallet support still matters.

projects.name: Cellframe
projects.chart_note: Main chain: PoS; zerochain: PoA · CF-20 only
projects.milestone_note: Native mainnet launched in July 2023.
projects.consensus_note: PoS on the main transaction chain; PoA on the zerochain.
projects.signing_note: Native-wallet options include Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+.
projects.agility_note: Multiple native signing schemes, subject to network and wallet support.
projects.caveat: Scope is native CF-20 assets, not ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens. Picnic is a historical/deprecated route, not a current wallet option in this release.

projects.name: QuantumCoin
projects.chart_note: Signing modes activate at protocol thresholds
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet launched on December 31, 2023.
projects.consensus_note: PoS with deposit-weighted BFT.
projects.signing_note: Hybrid post-quantum and Ed25519 signing; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA components.
projects.agility_note: Signing modes change at protocol thresholds and in emergency mode.
projects.caveat: Do not assume every protocol phase uses exactly the same component combination. ML-KEM node handshakes are not transaction signatures.

projects.name: QANplatform
projects.chart_note: Testnet uses PoA; transition to PoS is planned
projects.milestone_note: May 2024 is the public testnet announcement, not a public mainnet launch.
projects.consensus_note: PoA on the reviewed public testnet; PoS is planned.
projects.signing_note: XLINK pairs ML-DSA-65 with secp256k1.
projects.agility_note: A fixed signature pairing in the reviewed XLINK path.
projects.caveat: The traded QANX token does not establish a live native post-quantum mainnet. The original 2024 announcement used the Dilithium name; do not backdate current parameters.

projects.name: Neptune Cash
projects.chart_note: Current chain relaunched on Aug 5
projects.milestone_note: First launch in February 2025; the current chain relaunched on August 5, 2025.
projects.consensus_note: PoW.
projects.signing_note: Hash-preimage spending conditions and Triton STARK validity proofs.
projects.agility_note: Programmable lock scripts.
projects.caveat: A STARK proof and a hash-preimage spending condition are not a fixed-size standard digital signature.

projects.name: Nervos CKB
projects.timeline_milestone: Jan · SPHINCS+ lock deployed on mainnet
projects.chart_note: Chain launched in 2019; existing funds must migrate
projects.milestone_note: January 2026 marks the SPHINCS+ lock deployment. CKB mainnet launched in 2019.
projects.consensus_note: PoW, using NC-Max and Eaglesong.
projects.signing_note: An opt-in SPHINCS+ spending lock.
projects.agility_note: New verification logic can be deployed as lock scripts.
projects.caveat: Existing cells must satisfy their old spending rules before migration. Default secp256k1 cells do not change automatically.

projects.name: Quantus
projects.chart_note: ML-DSA-65 requires runtime spec 139+
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet launched on September 9, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: PoW with Poseidon2 mining.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65 transaction signing.
projects.agility_note: Parameter-set selection within ML-DSA.
projects.caveat: ML-DSA-65 requires runtime spec 139 or later and compatible account tooling. Quantus and qtcchain both use QTC but are separate chains.

projects.name: xCoin
projects.chart_note: Fallback key must be in the spending tree
projects.milestone_note: The project whitepaper dates mainnet genesis to September 26, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: PoW, using MetalDAG.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-65 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves.
projects.agility_note: Cross-family fallback requires committing to the alternative spending leaf in advance.
projects.caveat: This is not a claim that every spend carries both signatures or that a new fallback can be added after a key is compromised.

projects.name: qtcchain
projects.chart_note: Oct 5 v2 re-genesis; unrelated to Quantus
projects.milestone_note: v1 launched September 30, 2026; v2 re-genesis was October 5, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: PoW with MatMul mining.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-44 primary signing; SLH-DSA fallback/multisig.
projects.agility_note: Per-key scheme selection and multiple script leaves.
projects.caveat: Falcon is reserved in the reviewed specification. qtcchain is unrelated to Quantus despite the shared QTC ticker. The repository records a v2 treasury allocation; inclusion is not a fair-launch endorsement.

projects.name: Soqucoin
projects.chart_note: Scrypt PoW with AuxPoW support
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet block 1 was mined on October 13, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: Scrypt PoW with AuxPoW support.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-44 transaction signing.
projects.agility_note: One active transaction-signing scheme in the snapshot.
projects.caveat: XMSS experiments are not counted as a mainnet signing path. Public blocks do not establish user adoption or independent security certification.

projects.name: Splendor Quantum
projects.chart_note: One validator today; chain 2691 is separate

crypto_uses.scope: second signature on SQVL dual-signed instructions

projects.milestone_note: The current mainnet genesis was minted on September 21, 2026, after earlier resets.
projects.consensus_note: BFT with ML-DSA-65 votes; at review one validator certified blocks and public admission had not opened.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-65 for native transactions, blocks and validator votes; addresses are SHA3-256 of the public key.
projects.agility_note: One account signing scheme; the SQVL module adds dual ML-DSA-65 + SLH-DSA instructions.
projects.caveat: SPLD on the legacy Splendor EVM chain 2691 is a separate network until migrated. The repository states there is no third-party audit.

projects.name: Qbit
projects.chart_note: SHA-256 PoW plus AuxPoW merge mining
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet genesis was July 15, 2026; Qbit Core v1.0.0 followed on July 16.
projects.consensus_note: SHA-256 PoW with an AuxPoW merge-mining lane feeding the same chain.
projects.signing_note: OP_CHECKSIGPQC with a single SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30 profile inside P2MR outputs.
projects.agility_note: One active profile; reserved leaf versions allow a later soft fork to add another.
projects.caveat: The bounded profile is not a FIPS 205 parameter set and is safe only up to 2^30 signatures per key.

projects.name: Discrete
projects.chart_note: CryptoNote lineage; amounts public
projects.milestone_note: The project dates mainnet to July 15, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: PoW using DiscretePower, which binds each mining candidate to an ML-DSA-65 signature.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-65 spend authorization; ML-KEM-768 encapsulation for output delivery.
projects.agility_note: One active signing scheme; changing frozen parameters requires a hard fork.
projects.caveat: Spending reveals the long-term spend key and amounts are public in Phase 1; finality is node-local.

projects.name: Dilithion
projects.chart_note: RandomX PoW; DilV is a second chain
projects.milestone_note: The repository dates the mainnet launch (a fair-launch reset) to January 28, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: RandomX PoW; a VDF consensus phase is implemented but pending activation.
projects.signing_note: Dilithium mode 3 from the FIPS 204 reference code, i.e. ML-DSA-65 sizes and encoding.
projects.agility_note: One active signing scheme.
projects.caveat: DIL bridged to Base relies on Base accounts, not on Dilithium. The project uses the Dilithium3 name rather than ML-DSA-65.

projects.name: Parano1d
projects.chart_cryptography: Hash-based ZK spend proofs; no signatures
projects.chart_note: Own proof stack; Poseidon2b hash
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet genesis was August 21, 2026; v2 releases followed in October 2026.
projects.consensus_note: PoW orders blocks whose state transitions are already proven.
projects.signing_note: No public-key transaction signature: spends prove knowledge of a secret's Poseidon2b preimage.
projects.agility_note: Protocol versions activate at announced heights.
projects.caveat: A zero-knowledge proof of a hash preimage is not a standard digital signature, and the proof stack is not standardized. P2P peer identity uses Ed25519.

projects.name: Aere Network
projects.chart_note: ECDSA accounts remain the default

crypto_uses.scope: validator seals and header proposer seal

projects.milestone_note: Type-0x50 ML-DSA transactions were enabled on chain 2800 from block 19,900,000 (September 23, 2026).
projects.consensus_note: QBFT with ten validators, all run by the Aere Foundation at review.
projects.signing_note: Opt-in ML-DSA-44/65/87 transactions beside the default secp256k1 path; Falcon-512 and SLH-DSA validator seals.
projects.agility_note: The ML-DSA parameter set is chosen per transaction by an algorithm identifier.
projects.caveat: PQ accounts are opt-in; secp256k1 accounts, node transport and part of each consensus message remain classical. No completed third-party audit.

projects.name: QoreChain
projects.chart_note: EVM lane uses PQ-opened windows

crypto_uses.scope: required transaction signature; EVM window authorization

projects.milestone_note: Mainnet block 1 is dated June 29, 2026.
projects.consensus_note: CometBFT PoS; validator consensus keys were Ed25519 at review.
projects.signing_note: Every Cosmos-lane transaction carries a classical and an ML-DSA-87 signature; mainnet parameters require the hybrid form.
projects.agility_note: Enforcement mode (disabled/optional/required) and key migration are governed on chain.
projects.caveat: EVM transactions inside an open window are authorized by secp256k1 alone, and validator keys are classical.

projects.name: Minima
projects.chart_note: One-time keys; use counter matters
projects.milestone_note: CoinMarketCap dates the native coin's launch to November 26, 2024; no project source dating the mainnet launch was found.
projects.consensus_note: TxPoW: transactions carry their own proof of work, and blocks are formed from them.
projects.signing_note: KISS VM signature checks verify TreeKey signatures built from Winternitz one-time signatures (SHA3-256, w = 8).
projects.agility_note: Coins are locked by scripts, so the locking logic is programmable; the signature primitive itself is fixed in the node.
projects.caveat: One-time keys depend on correct use tracking, and the Winternitz key-tree construction is not a standardized scheme.
